label: Withhold giving: STIT choice cell or accessible per-effect non-giving
term: withholding giving (choice-cell control versus accessible non-giving)
resolution: The cell premise 0dd78706 uses WITHHOLD_1: agentive control over a whole choice cell of a STIT frame, with no claim about accessibility. Premise (a) fbd0a6d3 of the NAR route uses WITHHOLD_2: an accessible world where the root exists and does not give the recipient being, with no choice or control. Argument 19a0417f passes from sense 1 to sense 2 only through the admissibility premise 46a468b2, applied at the cell's representative; it does not carry the agentive content of sense 1 into premise (a). No argument passes from sense 2 to sense 1 for a given frame and map. For some representation the passage is available: with the branching frame and world map unconstrained and at most one actual root, the discrete partition turns each sense-2 witness into a one-history cell (cellsRepresentationIff). That is why sense 1 adds no constraint to premise (a) unless the partition and map are fixed independently. TOTAL_REFRAINING (6ce98992) is a separate, total notion: giving nothing at one world, not withholding one recipient.
